p: The fastest way to reach us is to call during office hours. Email is answered within two working days.
For placement, tell us the dancer's age, any previous training, and which days work for you. We will suggest a class to try.
Visitors are welcome to observe a class before enrolling. No appointment needed.
The studio is on the second floor above the bakery, entrance on the side street.
Lift access to both studios, changing rooms, and the observation area.
Tram stops directly outside. Street parking is free after 18:00 and all day Sunday.
Both studios are available for rehearsal, audition, and workshop hire outside class hours.
Sprung floors, full mirrors, sound system, and an upright piano in Studio A.
Hourly and day rates. Company and independent artist rates differ; ask.
We hire former professional dancers with a genuine interest in teaching children well.
Open enquiries are welcome year round even when no post is advertised.
Send training history, performing credits, and one paragraph on how you would teach a first plié.
